turn_text: Welcome to the Project 38 podcast, where we explore the state of the market and the future of government contracting. The market right now is being rocked by a partial government shutdown that has affected 800,000 government employees and hundreds of thousands of government contractors. We recently had the opportunity to talk with former Republican Congressman Tom Davis. Davis was a leader in Congress and led many efforts that involved procurement and government contracting. He left ten years ago to join Deloitte and helped build their federal practice, and he joined the law firm, Hala, and Knight, on January 1st. During our talk, we covered several different topics, but what follows is the section where Davis offered his thoughts on the shutdown.
